main_text.p: rum summo cum artificio pro Merito posuerint, ab aliis nullo cum negotio labefactantur illico. Quod nos ipsius veritatis victo-riæ tribuendum existimamus. Itâ tamen, ut in hosce sophistas optimè quadret illud Catonis scitum, Miror cur Haruspex non riserit, cùm Haruspicem viderit.

4. Est tamen ubi se prolixè ja-ctitant, ex Merito suo Gloriam Christi amplificari omnino, eò quòd asserant, Ex meritis Christi se accepisse illam suam virtutem merendi, per justitiæ æqualitatem apud Deum. page.notes: The first line reads "rum summo" with the long s printed as s. "pro" at the end of line 1 is read as pro; the abbreviation mark is not clear, so it is left plain. "labefactantur" and "asserant" are read with some uncertainty from the scan. The top right shows a faint letter, probably a stamp or show-through, not transcribed. The page number is not visible on this scan. The text at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is omitted. The catchword "singula" is printed with a long s, so it is written with a plain s.
